description: List the campaigns bound to a policy set, paginated, each with `id`, `name` and `is_archived`. `get_policy_set` returns only the first page of bindings plus a `campaigns_total`, so use this tool when a set has more campaigns than that page holds, or to search them by name. Read the membership here before `detach_policy_set_campaigns` — and before `delete_policy_set`, which the API refuses while any active campaign is still bound.
name: list_policy_set_campaigns
title: List Policy Set Campaigns
